product.name: Stovetop kettle, 1500 ml
product.description: Bring it out for a morning boil, packed in a cardboard cradle from a board mill, batch wool stall sixty seven.

blocks.text: Set it out for a morning boil after one night at the enamel shop, packed in paper and a cardboard edge, batch iron crock twenty three.
The kettle is steel with a wood handle and holds one and a half liters, batch birch rack thirty six.
It left the pottery yard on Sunday evening after edge-grain glue-up, and the batch is amber tray forty nine.
Bare steel is the note on batch river crate eighty, and empty the kettle after the boil and leave the lid ajar.
